purpose: Require a six-case regression gate before Graham production verification may begin.

cases.requirement: A scheduled Graham run may record NO_MATERIAL_CHANGE, must still leave a durable completion sweep, and must not fabricate rating or matchup movement.
A resolved governed personnel loss must move only the game-specific personnel overlay and fair through the production calculator, without changing the carried neutral team base.
Generated fair decomposition and researchSummary must exactly reconcile neutral base, home field, personnel, matchup and other governed adjustments to exact and displayed Graham fairs.
The active current-number board and active weekly research ledger must inherit cadence from graham-schedule-metadata-v1 and schedule synchronization must not mutate games or research sweeps.
Research/personnel production must reject marketViewed=true and the Pinnacle capture path may write only the market-comparison ledger, never Graham current numbers.
Reprocessing the same personnel case under a new event/batch must recompute the complete current overlay rather than stack the loss, and replaying an already processed batch must be idempotent.

passRule: All six cases must pass in one repository workflow run against the same main-branch revision.
